children: Yokohama India plans to expand its GEOLANDAR X-CV range from 32 to 37 locally manufactured tyre sizes to cater to India's growing crossover SUV segment

Yokohama India plans to add five new sizes to its GEOLANDAR X-CV tyre range, expanding its locally manufactured portfolio from 32 to 37 sizes. The expansion aims to address demand in India's growing crossover sport utility vehicle (SUV) segment.

Announced on 26 October, the planned addition will extend the range across 16-inch to 20-inch applications, covering compact, mid-size and larger premium SUVs. According to the company, the expanded portfolio is set to become India's largest dedicated crossover tyre range.
Five New Sizes To Expand Vehicle Coverage
The five new sizes will broaden the range's coverage across different vehicle fitments, giving customers more options for locally manufactured tyres.

The sizes include 215/65 R16, 205/55 R17, 215/55 R17, 235/65 R17 and 245/50 R20. The listed vehicle fitments include the Tata Curvv, older Jeep Compass, Volkswagen Taigun, Skoda Kushaq, Nissan Kylaq, Honda Elevate, Kia Carens, Mahindra XUV 3XO, MG Astor, MG ZS, Toyota Innova Crysta, Tata Harrier, Tata Safari, Mahindra XUV 500, Mahindra XUV 700, Volvo XC60 and Mahindra BE 6.
Yokohama India said the expansion responds to the changing requirements of the Indian SUV market, as new vehicle models and body styles increase the variety of tyre fitments required.

The company said the expansion is part of its ongoing efforts to increase local manufacturing and localise a larger share of its product portfolio, reducing dependence on imports for key product lines.
Harinder Singh, managing director of Yokohama India, said the expansion was an extension of the company's manufacturing strategy for India.

He said the SUV segment was growing and diversifying across price points and vehicle types, requiring the company's production capabilities to keep pace. Expanding GEOLANDAR X-CV to 37 locally produced sizes would strengthen its ability to serve the segment and reinforce its position in the premium tyre category.

Yokohama India is a wholly owned subsidiary of Japan-based The Yokohama Rubber Co. Ltd. The company offers tyres for passenger cars, SUVs and other automotive applications, supported by its manufacturing capabilities and distribution network across India, the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC) region and Africa.
